title: Nexus RunRequest
description: Request body for POST /v1/daemon/compute/run — invoke a compute module against an owned World (V1.147 P0 direct lane).

world_id.description: The World to run the module against. Must be owned by the active creator (ownership gate enforced server-side).

branch_id.description: Optional timeline branch to scope the run to. Defaults to the World root branch when omitted.

invocation_params.description: Module-specific invocation parameters (manifest-driven: attacker_id, defender_id, etc.). Keys ending in _id that correspond to required_key_block_types are resolved into KnowledgeEntry references during ComputeInput assembly.
